tasks.title: Scan markets and customers (last 7 days)
tasks.instructions: Find the changes in the named markets and customer segments in the last seven days. Every claim has a dated source link. Attach as 01-scan.md.

tasks.title: Analyse the named competitors
tasks.instructions: Track each named competitor's products, pricing and moves from primary sources, each with its date. Attach as 02-competitors.md.

tasks.title: Challenge every claim before filing
tasks.instructions: Challenge each claim in both reports and in each draft proposal. Each blocking objection is answered with evidence or the claim is dropped. Writes no findings of its own. Attach as 03-challenge.md.
